label: N-Channel MOSFET
description: N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET. Voltage-controlled: the gate draws no DC current, drain current is zero below the gate threshold voltage and rises with the square of gate overdrive above it.

properties.label: Vgs(th) (gate threshold voltage) — optional, overrides model's rating
k (transconductance coefficient) — optional, overrides model's rating

over_current.message: Drain current exceeded maximum rating. The MOSFET is destroyed. Check the drain load for too little resistance.

over_voltage.message: Vds exceeded breakdown voltage. Use a device rated for higher voltage, or reduce the supply.
